description: BAL-04 in the interface layer: road ambushes and quest goal fights spawn at most Battle.SOLO_MAX_ENEMIES enemies at once in early solo fights; the encounter enemy summary shows the same solo-curve numbers as the battle.

edits.name: Ambush enemy cap
edits.new: const n = Math.min(cap, B.SOLO_MAX_ENEMIES || 3, 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)); /* BAL-04: засада — одиночный бой, не больше SOLO_MAX_ENEMIES врагов */

edits.name: Goal fight enemy cap
edits.new: function prepareQuestEnemies(q){if(!q||!q.goals||!q.goals.length)return;const p=questProgress(q),a=[],e0=B.ENCOUNTERS[q.k],cap=e0&&e0.size===1&&B.SOLO_MAX_ENEMIES&&e0.level<15?B.SOLO_MAX_ENEMIES:3;/* BAL-04: в одиночном бою за целями не больше SOLO_MAX_ENEMIES врагов за раз */for(let i=0;i<q.goals.length&&a.length<cap;i++){const g=q.goals[i];const remaining=Math.min(g.count-(p[i]||0),cap-a.length);

edits.name: Enemy summary uses the solo curve
edits.old: Math.round(x.d.hp * f * (B.enemyCurve ? B.enemyCurve(e.level, 'hp') : 1)) + ' ХП, удар ~' + Math.round(x.d.atk * f * (B.enemyCurve ? B.enemyCurve(e.level, 'atk') : 1))
edits.new: Math.round(x.d.hp * f * (B.enemyCurve ? B.enemyCurve(e.level, 'hp', e.size === 1 && e.type !== 'dungeon') : 1)) + ' ХП, удар ~' + Math.round(x.d.atk * f * (B.enemyCurve ? B.enemyCurve(e.level, 'atk', e.size === 1 && e.type !== 'dungeon') : 1))
